assumptions: Only one AVB class (Class A, PCP=6) present; no higher or lower priority traffic considered on any port.
Thus l_>i^{h,max} = 0 for all h, implying c_max = 0 for Class A on all ports.
Frame size l_f equals the given payload (Bytes) as specified by the problem statement.
No explicit serialization delay beyond CBS network calculus; per-hop fixed 1us switching + 1us propagation used as provided.

class_A_CBS.c_max_formula: c_max = idleSlope * (sum_{j<i} c_min - l_>i^{max}) / (sum_{j<i} idleSlope - C)

queue_mapping.note: All egress ports use queue 6 for PCP=6

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve: For each flow f at its source h0: alpha_f^h0(t) = b_f + rho_f * t, with b_f = l_f (Bytes), rho_f = l_f / P_f (Bytes/us).
WCD_calculation.aggregate_arrival_per_port: alpha_M^h(t) = sum over all flows crossing port h of alpha_f^h(t). We use affine form: alpha_M^h(t) = B_h + r_h * t, with B_h = sum l_f, r_h = sum (l_f / P_f).
WCD_calculation.CBS_parameters: sendSlope = idleSlope - C; c_min = sendSlope * l_max / C; c_max from given formula; with single class and no lower-priority we set c_max = 0.
WCD_calculation.service_curve_per_port: beta_M^h(t) = idleSlope * [ t - c_max / idleSlope ]^+ => beta(t) = R * [t - T]^+ with R = 9.375 Bytes/us and T = 0.
WCD_calculation.per_hop_delay_bound: D_h = hDev(alpha_M^h, beta_M^h) = T + B_h / (R - r_h) = B_h / (R - r_h), since T = 0.
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum over egress ports h on f's route of D_h + hop_count * (prop_delay + switch_delay) = sum D_h + H * (1 us + 1 us).

missing_inputs: Max lower-priority (best-effort) frame size l_>i^{h,max} at each port (used by c_max). Assumed 0 (no lower-priority traffic).
Any non-AVB traffic presence and parameters (not provided).
Layer-2 frame overheads. We used payload as frame size per the problem definition.
Whether time synchronization error (1 us) should be added to WCD (not specified in the WCD sum).

assumptions.classes: Only AVB Class A (PCP=6) used on all switch egress queues considered.
assumptions.frame_size_l_f: Used payload bytes from Flows as l_f (no L2/L3 overhead provided).
assumptions.credit_upper_bound: No lower-priority/BE traffic specified; set l_{>i}^{max}=0 at all ports -> c_max=0.
assumptions.cut_through: Switches are cut-through; still applied 1 us switching delay per hop as provided.
assumptions.arrival_propagation: Total-Flow Analysis per port; used aggregate affine burst B=sum(l_f) and rho=sum(l_f/P_f) without per-hop deconvolution refinement.
assumptions.time_sync_error: Provided but not added to WCD since not part of the specified equations.

CBS_globals.sigma_CBS_intercept_bytes: 1.25 * l_max per port (= l_max + (c_max - c_min) with c_max=0, c_min=-0.25*l_max)
CBS_globals.c_max_formula: idleSlope * (sum higher-class c_min - l_>i^max)/(sum higher-class idleSlope - C) -> with no higher classes and l_>i^max=0, c_max=0

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve_per_flow: alpha_f(t) = b_f + rho_f * t with b_f = l_f (bytes), rho_f = l_f / P_f (bytes/us), t>0
WCD_calculation.aggregate_arrival_per_port: alpha_A^h(t) = sum_f alpha_f(t) AND sigma_link AND sigma_CBS; here yields effective burst B=sum(l_f), rate rho=sum(l_f/P_f)
WCD_calculation.sigma_CBS: idleSlope * t + (c_max - c_min) + l_max; with c_min = sendSlope * l_max / C = -0.25*l_max; c_max=0
WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve: beta_A^h(t) = idleSlope * [t - c_max/idleSlope]^+ -> rate R = 9.375 bytes/us, latency T = 0
WCD_calculation.per_port_delay_bound: D_port = hDev(alpha_agg, beta) = B / (R - sum_rho) + T; with T=0
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum_over_switch_egress_on_path(D_port) + hop_count * (propagation_delay + switching_delay) = sum D_port + hop_count * 2 us

Exact L2/L3 overhead to convert payload to on-wire frame size; used payload as frame size

equations.arrival_curve_source: alpha_f^h0(t) = b_f + rho_f * t for t>0, with b_f = l_f, rho_f = l_f / P_f
equations.arrival_curve_propagation: alpha_f^h(t) = alpha_f^(h-) deconvolved with delta_{D_f^(h-)}(t) (pure delay)
equations.aggregate_arrival_curve: alpha_{M}^h(t) = sum_{h-, f in class M} [ min( alpha_{M}^{h-,h}(t), sigma_link^{h-,h}(t), sigma_{M}^{h-,h}(t) ) ]
equations.cmax: c_{M}^{h,max} = idleSlope * ( sum_{j<i} c_{M_j}^{h,min} - l_{>i}^{h,max} ) / ( sum_{j<i} idleSlope_{M_j} - C )
equations.per_port_delay: D_M^h = hDev( alpha_{M}^h, beta_{M}^h ) = b_total / (R - rho_total) + T, with R=idleSlope, T=c_max/idleSlope
equations.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = (sum over ports h in path of D_M^h) + hop_count * (prop_delay + switch_delay) + time_sync_error

notes: All flows are AVB Class A (PCP 6) and share the same queue per egress port.

Under the given load, aggregate rho_total << R for all ports, so the CBS/link shaping 'min' does not further tighten alpha beyond sum of affine arrivals; service curve is CBS rate-latency with T=0 due to no BE assumption.

CBS_credit_bounds_and_service_curve.service_curve_beta: beta(t) = idleSlope * [ t - c_max / idleSlope ]^+ = 9.375 * [t - 0]^+ (B/us, us)
CBS_credit_bounds_and_service_curve.cbs_shaping_curve: sigma_CBS(t) = idleSlope * t + (c_max - c_min) + l_max with c_max=0, c_min<0

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve: alpha_f(t) = b_f + rho_f t at source; aggregated alpha_A^h(t) = sum_over_ingress min(alpha, sigma_link, sigma_CBS). We conservatively use B = sum(b_f), r = sum(rho_f).

credit_bounds.c_max: c_max = IdleSlope * (sum_j<i c_min_j - l_>i^max) / (sum_j<i IdleSlope_j - C). Assumed no higher classes and no lower-priority traffic => c_max=0

CBS_formulas.CBS_service_curve: beta_Mi^h(t) = IdleSlope * [ t - c_max/IdleSlope ]^+ (with c_max=0 => beta slope 75 b/us, zero latency)

CBS_formulas_used.beta_rate_latency: beta_Mi^h(t) = IdleSlope * [t - c_max/IdleSlope]^+; here R=IdleSlope, T=c_max/IdleSlope=0

arrival_curves_used.per_flow: alpha_f(t) = b_f + rho_f * t with b_f = l_f (Bytes), rho_f = l_f / P_f (Bytes/us)
arrival_curves_used.aggregate_per_port: alpha_Mi^h(t) = sum_f alpha_f(t) over flows on port h (all AVB_A), AND with link/cbs shaping curves (non-binding for computed loads)

WCD_equations.per_port_delay: D_h = hDev(alpha_Mi^h, beta_Mi^h) = b_total / (R - rho_total) + T, with R=IdleSlope, T=0

equations_used.arrival_curve: alpha_f(t) = b_f + rho_f * t, with b_f = l_f (Bytes), rho_f = l_f / P_f (Bytes/us)
equations_used.aggregate_arrival: alpha_Mi^h(t) = sum_f alpha_f^h(t) AND sigma_link AND sigma_CBS (AND = min)
equations_used.CBS_service_curve: beta_Mi^h(t) = IdleSlope * [ t - c_max / IdleSlope ]^+, with IdleSlope = 0.75*C, c_max per class/port
equations_used.credit_bounds: c_min = sendSlope * l_Mi_max / C; c_max = IdleSlope * (sum_{j<i} c_min_j - l_>i^max) / (sum_{j<i} IdleSlope_j - C)
equations_used.per_port_delay: D_h = hDev(alpha_Mi^h, beta_Mi^h) = b_total / (R - rho_total) + T
equations_used.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum_h D_h + hop_count * (prop_delay + switching_delay) + time_sync_error

assumptions_for_application: Single AVB Class A (PCP=6) in use; no lower-priority traffic considered on links (l_>A^max=0) hence c_max=0 and T=0

Cut-through switching per-hop switching delay = 1 µs and propagation delay = 1 µs per hop; time sync error = 1 µs per flow
